name: Forbidden Vows
source:
You found yourself awakened in an open field of flowers before a voice that called out to you, seeking to protect you from the unknown. Another voice approaches you with malice and it's up to you if your story ends before the truth is unveiled or unveiled to continued with your choice determining the future for the two of you.

[From [url=https://leiphory.itch.io/forbidden-vows]Itch.io[/url]]
